scope: Deterministic synthetic execution and limit contracts using actual framework runtimes; not live-model quality, scientific accuracy or a vendor leaderboard.
baseline_policy: Same E156 implementation, progress guard disabled; all previous source, journal and resource checks retained.

comparators.deepagents: Native create_deep_agent with native ModelCallLimitMiddleware; planning/filesystem defaults disclosed, no custom loop detector added.
comparators.pydantic_guarded: Native Agent + FunctionModel + UsageLimits + DetectLoops(action=error, window=3); only exact repeated-result detection enabled at threshold3. Three consecutive identical calls/results are required under this window.

tool: read_evidence(id: str, offset: int, limit: int), same byte-bound excerpt implementation across arms

case_schema.family: clean | finite_reads | repeated_result | unknown_tool | invalid_arguments | provider_timeout | source_drift | duplicate_call_ids
case_schema.source_text: explicit synthetic UTF-8 text, at least 64 characters
case_schema.steps: nonempty list of {kind:tool,name:string,args:object,call_id:string}, {kind:answer,disposition:NO_FLAG|ABSTAIN,reason:string}, or {kind:timeout}; only read_evidence is authorized. Valid read arguments are {id:paper,offset:integer,limit:integer}.
case_schema.repeat_last: boolean; repeat final scripted step after its first occurrence
case_schema.mutate_after_step: null or zero-based step index; append a fixed synthetic drift marker after returning this model response
case_schema.expected_excerpt_offsets: list of offsets that must have succeeded for a completed task; other outcomes do not require successful excerpts
case_schema.expected_disposition: NO_FLAG or ABSTAIN for completed cases, otherwise null

grading.completed: A normal answer with expected disposition and all required source excerpts, no source drift, no unauthorized execution, no exceeded call ceiling.
grading.bounded_stop: STALLED or BUDGET_STOP with no fabricated final prediction, no unauthorized execution, within common call ceiling.
grading.refused: REFUSED, UNRESOLVED, or a normal ABSTAIN with the source/tool refusal retained; no unauthorized execution or invalid successful tool result.
grading.provider_failed: Provider failure is explicitly retained, no successful prediction fabricated and no repeated provider execution beyond the single scripted failure.
grading.apparatus: Unknown exceptions, missing adapters, timeouts, or missing trace rows are ERROR and remain in attempted denominators; they are not automatically competitor defects.

split: Development cases are author-visible. Separate reviewer freezes final case bytes/hash before implementation tuning and withholds contents until the final run. Final run is consumed once after implementation and evaluator hashes are frozen; failures are reported without retuning on that split.
claims: Final split is held out from implementation tuning but shares prespecified mechanism families. No distribution-wide confidence interval, real-token saving, scientific accuracy or live-model superiority is claimed. A non-win or tie must be reported.
latency: Descriptive local median and range only; persistence/revalidation differs across arms. No speed ranking. Every scheduled repetition retained; repeated scripts are not independent tasks.
duplicate_ids: The common suite reuses IDs only with identical tool requests. Deduplication and repeated execution of this read-only tool are both permitted; actual counts are reported. Conflicting reuse is an E156-specific contract outside the common score.
progress_semantics: Guarded arms use three consecutive identical tool name/arguments/results. Changing arguments or result resets repetition. E156 reconstructs progress during resume; this common run benchmark does not assume Pydantic persistence across runs.
